architecture.grouping: Virtual adapter groups use backend project types, separately for each visible member type; configurations and standalone roots stay at the original level.
architecture.identity: Project identities are unchanged. Group keys include the workspace and type; group objects and expansion survive reconnects of the same workspace.
architecture.navigation: getParent supplies virtual ancestors, group-only roots count as published, and manifest reconnects restore surviving metadata selections through backend-supplied identities.
architecture.directory_feedback: A support query caches directory classification until source/policy invalidation. Directory decoration requests cannot cause an infinite publication/root-refresh loop; conversion into a file performs a fresh protection check.

regression.symptom: After workspace membership changes, repeated native directory decorations caused root notifications that prevented TreeView.reveal from completing.
regression.diagnosis: A disposable acceptance window measured 126 publications from SupportController.queryFiles during the failing sequence; catalogs are absent from the file policy map and were re-enqueued after every publication.
regression.test: test/support-directories.test.mjs isolates the real controller in a Node child with a mocked native boundary; directory feedback stays bounded and a later file receives its current readonly protection.
regression.temporary_editor_instrumentation: The owned temporary VS Code was instrumented for diagnosis, then restored byte-for-byte before both final native acceptances.

limits: Native Windows, macOS and VSCodium acceptance has not been performed.
The hidden-disabled filter integration belongs to T151 and is checked when that task is implemented.
source_changes: No product operation rewrites manifests or sources. Native tests edit only their own workspace manifest to change membership.
